# NorgeTravel: Local Travel Guides & Booking Assistant for Norway

NorgeTravel is an independent, authoritative local travel guide and mapping portal designed to help tourists navigate Norway's scenic destinations, planning logistics, and mountain safety regulations.

## About NorgeTravel
- **Location Focus:** All regions of Norway with specialized deep guides for Northern Norway, the Arctic circle, Svalbard, Lofoten, Senja, Alta, and the western fjords (Geirangerfjord, Nærøyfjord).
- **Core Value:** Providing accurate, local information on hiking safety, the DNT cabin system, wild camping laws (Allemannsretten), and seasonal winter driving rules.

## Core Travel Guides
- [Allemannsretten (Right to Roam)](https://norgetravel.com/travel-guides/safety/allemannsretten-right-to-roam): Legal rules for hiking, foraging, and wild camping in uncultivated outfields.
- [DNT Cabin Guide](https://norgetravel.com/travel-guides/planning/dnt-cabin-guide): Practical handbook on how to get the DNT key, cabin categories, and mountain hut etiquette.
- [Mountain Safety Code (Fjellvettreglene)](https://norgetravel.com/travel-guides/safety/fjellvettreglene-mountain-code): The 9 official rules for safe mountain crossing and winter survival.
- [Winter Driving Guide](https://norgetravel.com/travel-guides/planning/winter-driving-norway-tires-chains-road-closures): Laws on winter tires, studded fees, and seasonal mountain pass closures.

## Destination Hubs
- [Lofoten Islands](https://norgetravel.com/destinations/lofoten): Fishing villages, hiking paths, and cod-drying traditions.
- [Svalbard](https://norgetravel.com/destinations/svalbard): High-Arctic glacier treks, polar bear safety, and Longyearbyen lodging.
- [Alta](https://norgetravel.com/destinations/alta): Rock carvings, northern lights viewing, and the Sorrisniva Igloo Hotel.
- [Geirangerfjord](https://norgetravel.com/destinations/fjords/geirangerfjord): Scenic boat cruises, waterfalls, and hiking paths.

## Interactive Travel Services
- [Accommodation Map](https://norgetravel.com/travel/accommodation): Hotels, remote wilderness cabins, camping parks, and rorbuer.
- [Restaurants & Local Food](https://norgetravel.com/travel/restaurants): Seafood spots, traditional Lefse bakeries, and modern Nordic dining.
- [Experiences & Tours](https://norgetravel.com/travel/experiences): Fjord boat cruises, Northern Lights safaris, dog sledding, and hiking tours.
- [Local Guides Database](https://norgetravel.com/travel/guides): Professional authorized guides for mountaineering and Arctic crossings.
